title: Mykola Hrinchenko
summary: Mykola Volodymyrovych Hrinchenko is a retired Ukrainian professional football midfielder, born on 27 February 1986.

sections.heading: Early Life and Background
paragraphs: Mykola Hrinchenko was born on 27 February 1986 [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Football Career
paragraphs: Hrinchenko had a professional career as a football midfielder, representing [[ukraine|Ukraine]] in various competitions.

sections.heading: Retirement
paragraphs: Following his career as a professional footballer, Hrinchenko is recognized as a former player in the [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] football community.
